prompts.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: architecture concept for a local video workflow editor called Video Director, proposed design v0.1.
Create a polished, extremely clear landscape architecture diagram, 1920x1200 or similar, on a warm off-white background. Professional software architecture board with precise dark typography, subtle borders, thin arrows, generous white space. Blue means user/agent interfaces, violet means shared host operations, teal means local stores. All text large and readable. Flat vector-like illustration, no photographs, no perspective.
Title: "One command interface for people and agents". Subtitle: "Video Director • Proposed architecture".
Top row two equal large boxes "Sidebar + Canvas" and "DSH Agent". Small labels beneath: "click, drag, edit" and "plan, query, revise". Arrows from BOTH lead to a single wide central box "VD Command Interface".
Inside central box show 4 short pills: "Scope" "Revisions" "Response budgets" "Operation receipts".
Below split into four clear module boxes in one row: "Canvas" with "query • patch • history"; "Skills" with "discover • edit • load"; "Assets" with "import • inspect • reference"; "Runs + Quality" with "validate • execute • compare".
Arrows from the module row lead to one broad local storage container labeled "Local Video Director data folder", with compartments "workflows" "skill versions" "assets" "runs + reports".
Right-side separate small box labeled "DSH owns" with three lines "Conversations", "Model routing", "Credentials". Connect "DSH Agent" to this box with a subtle thin line, do not imply credentials are in the VD data folder.
A side callout next to the central interface: "Metadata first. Details only on request." Another small note below data folder: "UI and agents share validation, conflict handling and undo."
Include a small legend at bottom "Existing foundation: canvas tools + durable runs" and "Proposed: managed library + bounded queries + quality loop".
Do not imply a separate cloud database. Do not show any private project names, actual file paths, credential values, real workflow content, screenshots, brands other than Video Director and DSH. This is a conceptual proposal, not a screenshot of a shipped feature. Exact spellings and clean typography matter.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: product design plan and workflow for Video Director.
Create a refined landscape planning board, 1920x1200 or similar. Warm off-white background, dark navy text, blue and violet connectors, teal success accents, amber budget/stop accents. Flat professional editorial diagram with large readable labels, no photography or 3D.
Title: "Build, inspect, improve — within a budget". Subtitle: "Video Director • Proposed agent workflow".
Use upper 65% as two distinct sections. Left section heading "Read only what is needed". Four descending cards linked by downward arrows: "1  Overview" subtitle "IDs, revisions, counts"; "2  Relevant graph" subtitle "selection + nearby nodes"; "3  Selected fields" subtitle "prompts or settings on demand"; "4  Evidence" subtitle "chosen frames, clips or reports". Under the stack put "Every response has a size limit and continuation cursor."
Right section heading "A recorded iteration loop". Six clearly numbered boxes, joined by directional arrows in a loop: "Understand" → "Plan + checks" → "Apply draft" → "Run affected nodes" → "Inspect evidence" → "Refine or accept". Route a curved arrow from "Refine or accept" back to "Apply draft", label it "only if budget remains". From finalbox a separate short arrow to teal "Accepted checkpoint". Below the loop a slim amber strip "Stop: pass • budget • repeated failure • human edit". Evidence card note "Quality verdicts include evidence and uncertainty." No claim of guaranteed aesthetic quality.
Bottom 30% is a horizontal roadmap with five numbered stages and readable exact labels: "1. Protocol contract", "2. Skills + library", "3. Full UI/agent parity", "4. Quality loop", "5. Recovery + large canvases". Beneath roadmap one line: "First vertical slice: create a skill → load it → edit a synthetic workflow → inspect → undo."
This is only a proposed design, not an implemented feature. All examples synthetic. No user content, credentials, personal paths, or screenshots. Prioritize clear arrow directions and balanced whitespace over ornament.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity product concept board for a local node-based video workflow editor called Video Director.
Create a crisp landscape 2048x1280 design board with two large desktop application panels side-by-side and a thin title strip above: "Video Director — sidebar interaction proposal". Small top badge "Concept • synthetic example". Use realistic polished desktop UI, dark midnight navy surfaces, hairline blue-gray dividers, readable white and slate text, restrained electric blue and violet accents, generous spacing. Do not make a marketing website.
Panel A, slightly wider, heading "A. Chat builds the canvas". It shows an editor with a left sidebar occupying about 45% and a dark dotted node canvas on the right. Sidebar top: project label "Studio demo", status "Draft saved", tabs "Chat  Skills  Assets  Runs" with Chat selected. Under tabs show skill chips "storyboard v1.2" and "quality-check v1.0". A synthetic user bubble: "Make a 10-second product video. Keep the logo readable." Agent card: "Plan" with three short numbered lines "Build 3 shots", "Connect render nodes", "Check logo + pacing". Next a compact card "Draft changes" with "+3 nodes   +2 links" and buttons "Inspect" "Undo". Next teal/amber report card "Quality check" with "Logo: pass" and "Pacing: revise", action "Refine affected shot". Sidebar bottom small context strip "2 nodes selected · details on demand", large composer placeholder "Describe the next change...", plus icon, model selector "Local vision model", and Send button. Canvas shows four clean purple/blue nodes connected with valid left-to-right arrows, short node labels "Reference", "Storyboard", "Render", "Preview". A tiny preview contains abstract geometric product imagery only.
Panel B heading "B. Skills are editable local bundles". A focused sidebar skills workspace with tabs "Chat  Skills  Assets  Runs", Skills selected. Toolbar has search "Find skills", buttons "New skill" and "Import". Two list rows "storyboard" with "v1.2 · Project" and "quality-check" with "v1.0 · Library". A selected skill editing card below: heading "storyboard", description "Plan shots and connect a draft workflow." Tabs "Instructions  Resources  History". Instructions selected and three short lines "Read the brief.", "Query relevant nodes.", "Build a draft and define checks." Under it small file chips "shot-template.json" and "references/". Bottom buttons "Save version" and "Load in chat"; subtle status "Loaded version stays pinned for this run".
Maintain readable typography, realistic controls and visual hierarchy. No terminal commands, raw JSON, huge API schemas or implementation jargon inside user flows. No actual user workflow data, credentials, local paths, screenshot references or stock logos. This is a new imagined UI with synthetic content, not an edit of any attached image.
